Select the combination of signs that when sequentially placed in the given blanks will make the equation correct.

7 _ 3 _ 4 _ 12 _ 6 = 19
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55cf23d9dc22fa10bb56199cdce71fa3db375d290968e0676171f8d7e9ba3655.png] 

First we will check all the options as:

1) ×, -, +, ÷

Applying the signs, we will get,

⇒ 7 × 3 - 4 + __**12 ÷ 6**__ = 19

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ __**7 **____**×**____** 3**__ - 4 + 2 = 19

⇒ __**21 - 4 + 2**__ = 19

⇒ 19 = 19, is possible

2) ÷, ×, +, -

Applying the signs, we will get,

⇒ __**7 ÷ 3**__ × 4 + 12 - 6 = 19

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ __**2.33 ×**____** 4**__ + 12 - 6 = 19

⇒ __**9.32 + 12 - 6**__ = 19

⇒ 15.32 ≠ 19, is not possible

3) -, ×, +, ÷

Applying the signs, we will get,

⇒ 7 - 3 × 4 + __**12 ÷ 6**__ = 19

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 7 - __**3 **____**×**____** 4**__ + 2 = 19

⇒ __**7 - 12 + 2**__ = 19

⇒ -3 ≠ 19, is not possible

4) +, ÷, ×, -

Applying the signs, we will get,

⇒ 7 + __**3 ÷ 4**__ × 12 - 6 = 19

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 7 + __0.75** ×**____** 12**__ - 6 = 19

⇒ __**7 + 9 - 6**__ = 19

⇒ 10 ≠19, is not possible

Thus, the combination of signs '**×, -, +, ÷**' placed in the given blanks will make the equation correct.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

22 - 16 ÷ (3 × 4) + 6 = 8

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab9003ba65914e9db049e6f510b5740718252ca1bdf98a9ac303e65c8cd29d3e.png] 

First we will check all the options as:

1) - and ×

Applying the signs we will get,

⇒ 22 × 16 ÷ (__**3 - 4**__) + 6 = 8

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 22 × __**16 ÷ (-1)**__ + 6 = 8

⇒ __**22 **____**×**____** (-16)**__ + 6 = 8

⇒ __**352 + 6**__ = 8

⇒ 358 ≠ 8, is not possible

2) ÷ and ×

Applying the signs we will get,

⇒ 22 - 16 × (__**3 ÷ 4**__) + 6 = 8 

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 22 - __**16 × (0.75)**__ + 6 = 8

⇒ __**22 - 12 + 6**__ = 8

⇒ 16 ≠ 8, is not possible

3) ÷ and +

Applying the signs we will get,

⇒ 22 - 16 + (__**3 × 4**__) ÷ 6 = 8 

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 22 - 16 + __**(12) ÷ 6**__ = 8

⇒ __**22 - 16 + 2**__ = 8 

⇒ 8 = 8, is possible

4) - and +

Applying the signs we will get,

⇒ 22 + 16 ÷ __**(3 × 4)**__ - 6 = 8 

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

⇒ 22 + __**16 ÷ 12**__ - 6 = 8

⇒ 22 + 1.33 - 6 = 8

⇒ 17.33 ≠ 8, is not possible

Thus, two signs '**÷ and +**' should be interchanged to make the following equation correct.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.

B-12 = 0.5(C+12)

B = number of students in biology

B - 12 = 0.5C + 6

B = 0.5C + 18

Now, let's put the value of B in the first equation formed.

0.5C + 18 + C = 150

1.5C = 132

C = 132/1.5 = 88

Since, 12 students shifted from biology to chemistry,

**the numbers of students in chemistry now = 88 = 12 = 100**

questions.question: _______ is an environment friendly and useful method of conversion of rural and urban organic waste into good quality manure.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vermicomposting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vermicomposting** is the scientific method of making compost in which the earthworms convert the organic waste into manure rich in high nutritional content.
 
• Earthworms preys on the organic waste materials and give out “vermicasts” which are rich in nitrates and minerals such as phosphorus, magnesium, calcium and potassium.
 
• These are used as fertilizers and it enhances soil quality.
 
• **Advantages of Vermicomposting:**
 
 
• It develops roots of the plants.
 
• Highly improves the body of the soil.
 
• Vermicomposting increases the fertility and water-resistance properties of the soil.
 
• Helps in the germination, plant growth, and crop yield.
 
• Nourish soil with plant growth hormones like auxins, gibberellic acid, etc.
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of Vermicomposting:**
 
 
• It is a long and time-consuming process and takes almost six months to convert the organic matter into usable forms.
 
• It releases a very foul odour.
 
• Vermicomposting requires high maintenance. The feed should be added periodically and care should be taken that the worms are not flooded with too much to eat.
 
• The bin should not be too dry or too wet. The moisture levels need to be checked periodically.
 
• They support the expansion of pests and pathogens such as fruit flies, centipede and flies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Illuviation:** It is the accumulation of dissolved or suspended soil materials in one area or layer as a result of leaching from another.
 
• **Leaching: **Leaching is the loss of soluble substances and colloids from the highest layer of soil by percolating precipitation.
 
• **Eluviation:** It is the removal of dissolved or suspended material from a layer or layers of the soil by the movement of water when rainfall exceeds evaporation.
